relationships.subject: sustained depolarization
relationships.evidence_quote: Total voltage-gated sodium currents were significantly reduced in cells treated with KCl compared with control media

relationships.subject: sustained depolarization
relationships.evidence_quote: show that there is an overall decrease in neuronal excitability of sensory neurons following a sustained depolarization

key_findings: 24 h sustained depolarization (30 mM KCl) reversibly decreases excitability of mouse and human DRG neurons.
Sodium currents were reduced while potassium currents were unchanged; 1 Hz optogenetic firing did not induce the adaptation.
